notes.title: Graphics Improvement Update (Ver.2.02.00)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Here’s a long-awaited update.
We have improved and replaced some of the graphics.

The new backgrounds have been beautifully enhanced by Tigu, who also worked on other titles and the upcoming sequel, No Ghost in the Circus Caravan.

Circus Caravan is scheduled for release on September 25, 2024.
Release sale is also planned, so please add it to your wishlist and look forward to it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2733820/_/

notes.title: mini update (Ver2.01.05)
notes.notes:
Good job, everyone, we've made some improvements:

Fixed an issue where some Italian translations weren't reflected properly and made further improvements to the translation.
Fine-tuned the conditions for specific endings and made corresponding adjustments to the hint icons.

'Hospital' seems to be a popular guess for the next 'No Ghost' series! Followed by 'school' and others. It's a hotspot for spooks! 👻
Feel free to share your guesses too. The setting for the next game has already been decided.

notes.title: Correction Update (Ver1.02.01) and The Important Notice
notes.notes:
[h2]🌱About the Update[/h2]
I have added effects and graphics to some of the endings. Also, I've made improvements so that you can understand essential systems such as purchasing hints even if you overlook the tips.

[h2]🌱About the Halloween Update[/h2]

Last year, in line with Steam's Scream Fest (Halloween event), I conducted the ending addition and Halloween update for [No Ghost in Stay Home].
This year, I was busy and struggling with the new work, but I received voices that were looking forward to the update, so I also decided on [No Ghost in Sky Elevator].
I am thinking about adding about 10 endings. There are already more ideas than that, and the content, including the existence of the true ending, is almost solidified.

In the Halloween additional endings, [b]you might find out a significant fact about the protagonist, Yumi...[/b]

Please look forward to it! 🤗
That's all for now.

🌱If you notice anything else, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Please contact us at the official e-mail address, or X!
